one_sentence_story: A warm source artifact sends one continuous evidence thread through a transparent Context Capsule, where a torus family and cusp hexagonal fibre make one bounded transformation before the trace closes as an explicitly provisional S6 paper claim.

beats.title: SOURCE CAPTURE
beats.causal_move: The source artifact is isolated as the only starting object.
beats.visual_action: A warm paper artifact rises from a dark hexagonal platform; a single amber source marker locks to its lower edge.

beats.title: THREAD RELEASE
beats.causal_move: The locked source marker becomes one luminous evidence stream.
beats.visual_action: One deterministic amber-to-white bezier thread leaves the marker and travels across the terrain; no second stream or dashboard appears.

beats.title: CAPSULE TEST
beats.causal_move: The stream enters the transparent Context Capsule and is locally constrained by the cusp fibre.
beats.visual_action: A glass capsule fades in around the existing thread; three fixed torus rings settle around a six-sided cusp fibre while the thread makes one visible bend.

beats.title: TRACE EXIT
beats.causal_move: The constrained stream exits cold-blue and lands on a receipt/world-trace marker.
beats.visual_action: The same thread exits the capsule, crosses the blue side of the terrain, and terminates at a white receipt strip above a dark world-trace platform.

beats.title: BOUNDED CLAIM
beats.causal_move: The observed trace is labelled as a paper claim with its falsification condition still open.
beats.visual_action: A compact claim card appears beside the receipt; the thread remains visible behind it so the claim cannot detach from its source path.

caption_script: A source artifact enters the frame.
One evidence thread carries the causal move.
Inside the Context Capsule, the cusp fibre constrains the torus family.
The trace exits with a receipt and a world-facing check.
S6 is shown here as a paper claim, not a consensus fact. Test the trace; keep the falsifier open.

manim_plan.coordinate_frame: fixed Manim frame from x=-8 to 8 and y=-4.5 to 4.5
manim_plan.randomness: none; no random seed, noise, or procedural variation

geometry.torus_family: three ParametricFunction rings with radii 0.72, 0.56, 0.39 and fixed z-order
geometry.cusp_hexagonal_fibre: Polygon with fixed six vertices around [0.0,-0.15,0], plus one fixed inward cusp notch
geometry.terrain: fixed hexagonal platform polygons only; no generated texture

timing: 4.5-7.0 capsule, torus family, and cusp fibre FadeIn

manim_plan.text_rule: Use Manim Text with the exact short labels in the beats; do not render pseudo-document lines as evidence.

falsifier: An independent reconstruction or observed counter-trace that preserves the same source and context but fails to produce the claimed cusp-fibre constraint, or produces a different trace under the stated mapping, would refute this proposed S6 claim. The film itself cannot serve as the evidence.
source_boundary: The supplied image is used only for visual grammar: warm source, luminous stream, transparent capsule, torus/cusp structure, and cold receipt/world trace. It is not operational evidence.
